_comment: little-coder models override (installed to ~/.config/little-coder/models.json by docker/entrypoint-agent.sh). Points the llamacpp provider at the ai-stack llama-swap endpoint and registers the model ids llama-swap actually serves (qwen36-27b), which differ from upstream's bundled models.json (qwen3.6-27b). contextWindow MUST track the qwen36-27b per-request lane (ctx-size / n_parallel) -> 60000 since 2026-07-09 (speculative decoding forced ctx 262144->180000, parallel 3). See ai-stack/.env 'qwen36-27b LANE CONSUMERS'. Restart little-coder after changing.
